shots.detail_en: Hook close-up: mopping, Chang Hong's pocket watch slips out, hits the floor and springs open — engraved glint inside the lid flashes past, only 'there IS writing' is readable
shots.sub: 满："哟！铁疙瘩上还刻着字？"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong snatches it back unnaturally fast, knuckles white
shots.sub: 满："抢啥！我又不押它！"
shots.speaker: MANCANG

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: behind the counter Hongli witnesses the grab, her pen tip frozen on the ledger
shots.sub: 红（自语）："他护它，像护命。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Montage: Hongli pulls the old watch-repair shop registry / Chang Hong audits as usual / at night she pins the registry page beside the prediction slip on a corkboard
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Close-up: repair registry column reveals the registered owner — 'Lu Zhenhai' (hard evidence)
shots.sub: 红（倒吸气）："修表的人……和写字的人，一个姓。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli uses a 'badge annual check' excuse to hold back Chang Hong's file page
shots.sub: 红："陆先生，令尊的名字？" 长："不在户口本上，在表里。"
shots.speaker: RED/CH

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Chang Hong walks off, knuckles still clenched, glances back at the counter
shots.sub: 长（旁白）："她的眼睛在过账。这一次，过的是我的账。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Wide long take: Chang Hong sweeps dust beneath the giant flip board and looks up at the whole wall of prices, tiny against it
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: 1993 flashback: at the repair shop counter a 12-year-old boy tiptoes to watch the smith rejoin the broken watch chain, the same registry on the counter
shots.sub: 男孩："能修好吗？" 匠："链断了能接，时间接不回。"
shots.speaker: BOY/匠人

shots.detail_en: Close-up: back to present, Chang Hong rubs the chain joint, a flicker of moisture in his eyes quickly held back
shots.sub: 长（低）："接上了。就是慢一分钟。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli blocks him and lays out the registry photocopy — 'Lu Zhenhai' circled in red
shots.sub: 红："最后一次问你——预测单的'陆'，是哪个陆？"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong silent three beats, unbuttons his cuff, places the pocket watch on the counter, lid popping open toward her
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Visual-peak macro: engraving inside the lid — 'To Brother Zhenhai, through wind and rain — Shen' (the watch was a gift from the Shen family, the old bond made real)
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Hongli looks down at her own calculator pendant, pupils shaking — two heirloom objects of two fathers in one frame
shots.sub: 红（颤声）："这块表……我爸的抽屉里，有一张一样的提货单。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Chang Hong closes the lid and retightens his tie to the throat (the tie never loosened since '93 — visual anchor)
shots.sub: 长："沈红利。我姓陆。我父亲——陆振海。"
shots.speaker: CH

shots.detail_en: Explosive wide: the two stand facing each other across the counter, the hall behind them dissolving into drifting red-green light blobs
shots.sub: 无

shots.detail_en: Two-shot: Hongli records nothing, tells no one, folds the registry photocopy and presses it to the deepest corner of her drawer
shots.sub: 红："今天这一页，账上没有。"
shots.speaker: RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: the drawer locks, key in macro; Chang Hong watches the whole sequence
shots.sub: 长："为什么？" 红："账房的规矩——老朋友的账，先挂账，后算账。"
shots.speaker: CH/RED

shots.detail_en: Mid shot: Man Cang passes with milk tea, reads the weird vibe between the two and steps back half a pace
shots.sub: 满："你俩……对账对出感情了？" 长／红（同时）："盘你的货去。"
shots.speaker: MANCANG/CH/RED

shots.detail_en: Close-up: Chang Hong's back as he leaves, hand brushing the watch pocket — for the first time without wariness (trust sprouting)
shots.sub: 长（旁白）："那晚我明白——账，也能是暖的。"
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Black screen with next-episode card
shots.sub: 字幕："可沈红利的抽屉里，那张旧照片还压着——照片上，两个父亲的中间，站着谁？"
shots.card: 可沈红利的抽屉里，那张旧照片还压着——照片上，两个父亲的中间，站着谁？
